sloka: बभूवतुश्चात्मजये यत्तौ भीमपराक्रमौ।तौ शरौघैस्तदा कीर्णौ निकृत्तकवचध्वजौ।स्रवन्तौ रुधिरं चोष्णं जलं प्रस्रवणाविव ।। ६.८९.२५ ।।
transliteration: babhūvatuścātmajaye yattau bhīmaparākramau।tau śaraughaistadā kīrṇau nikṛttakavacadhvajau।sravantau rudhiraṁ coṣṇaṁ jalaṁ prasravaṇāviva ।। 6.89.25 ।।

translations.english: Both heroes, being experts in fighting, tore each other with sharp arrows for long.
